verdict.rationale: Sentry documents official SDKs as the primary integration path, with a link to its platforms page and "Monitor in five lines" ([sentry-docs-12], [sentry-docs-16]). An AI-native install command teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Grok to install and configure Sentry ([sentry-docs-1], [sentry-docs-19]), and OTel SDK ingestion is also supported ([sentry-docs-25]). A community user reports deep product integration aided by the open-source code ([sentry-comm-1]). Missing for 10: the specific languages and platforms the SDKs cover, in-depth SDK reference documentation in the pack, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
